description: mergequeue.vocabulary is DERIVED, never hand-copied (MQ17): the states walk mergequeue.StatusSet and every legalNext edge is probed through the same mergequeue.Legal the driver moves by, so a screen cannot show an edge the driver would refuse; reasons, modes, policies and land methods come from the closed sets themselves; methods and their door kinds come from the plane's own registration list. Adding a status constant changes this answer with no handler edit anywhere.

states.name: queued
states.meaning: on the lane, waiting its turn; the loop has not started or has not been needed

states.name: catching_up
states.meaning: the integration branch is being built (or rebuilt after the base moved)

states.name: verifying
states.meaning: the gate runs against the integration head — the queue's own S57 verification

states.name: ready
states.meaning: the gate is green for this head; a manual queue waits for a person's land, an auto queue lands on its grants

states.name: merging
states.meaning: the landing is in flight: the PR and the merge are the loop's work now

states.name: merged
states.meaning: landed on base; landed_sha names the commit; the worktrees are cleaned

states.name: conflicted
states.meaning: the integration merge conflicts; the resolve-or-ask plane owns the exit (paths and counts only, SEC-033)

states.name: failed
states.meaning: ended short — reason_kind names the family (denied, gate-failed, head-moved, catchup-limit, loop-stopped, …)

states.name: removed
states.meaning: taken out of the queue by a person or the stop contract; the branch and its commits are untouched
